description: Fens in calm park Kampina early spring. Netherlands. W Middle of a natural reserve in the Netherlands called “De Kampina”. It is a park of heathland and fens forest. Not many birds can be heard on this March day. In front of the mics a little bird forages for food among the leaves on the ground. It rustles nicely. More here today / More around here during the year Date/time: March 27th Wednesday 2019, start 11:49 AM Weather: 10c, clouded, wind WNW 2bft with gusts to 10 km/h, 1034 hPa, humidity 63%.
